content.text: Summary: Checked the search namespace and found docindex-3 not Ready (readiness probe 503) and docindex-4 missing. Logs showed the app joined as standby because CLUSTER_SIZE=3 while its ordinal is 3. Confirmed via docs that default StatefulSet OrderedReady management blocks creation of docindex-4 until docindex-3 is Ready. Resolved T-6002 with instructions to raise CLUSTER_SIZE to 5 in the pod template/ConfigMap and roll the pods.
